status: Selected historical observations, separate from D1. V4, V7 fixed checks and B1 are not pooled or a unified benchmark. Pending independent delta review and owner editorial approval. Counts and factual summaries only; no source, patches, queries or captures.

v4.population: Selected historical coding tasks: one native-first and one SQL-first session per task. Descriptive single draws, not causal effects or estimated success rates.

httpx.usage_definition: Cumulative runtime-recorded provider input tokens, including repeated context. Unique response records count pre-failure input once in the interrupted and resumed native session.

tenacity.diagnostic_status: Separate retrospective diagnostic: each final production patch with original tests and the unchanged frozen oracle overlay. Does not replace frozen grading. The original native broader-suite result had test-overlay collection interference. These are regressions in agent-authored patches, not upstream defects.

v7_fixed_check.population: One selected cross-file dispatch task in evaluator-authored, oracle-assisted fixed checks. No consumer sessions; not an agent outcome or a recall benchmark.
v7_fixed_check.qualification: Native reformulation and direct navigation supply useful candidates/path information; broad edge-first SQL withholds seed-node rows at its serialized UTF-8 byte cap. Different response populations; neither establishes complete dispatch behavior.

b1.population: Five deliberately selected historical relationship questions, with preserved native records and analyst-designed scoped SQL; two supporting cases below. Reuses historical evidence, including V4 and V7 records, rather than adding independent agent trials.
b1.qualification: Case-specific necessary navigation subsets, not pooled recall. Focused SQL is analyst-designed and source-informed, not observed unfamiliar-agent formulation. Native refinement is also successful. Emitted output is distinct from verified model delivery. Stored relationships do not establish behavior, source completeness or avoided source reads.
